text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, which girl are you keeping an eye 
on in today's race?”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? With this 
lineup, Eishin Flash is the only choice!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Right~. With "this lineup," it's pretty 
much gotta be Eishin Flash—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The day of the Keisei Hai. Attention on 
Eishin Flash was remarkably high among the 
runners, but..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call that a positive 
assessment. It's a passive choice.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I want to live up to those 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, rather... I must be someone worthy of 
living up to expectations.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This race is merely a stepping stone. I 
cannot afford to stumble here.
choice_data_list:
You'll be just fine as long as you run 
like your usual self.

You'll be fine if you just run like you 
always do.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, just as always. I will do what 
must be done.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And we'll carry this momentum into the 
first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the 
Satsuki Sho.
